FQCARDDESCRIPTION.ChiMaster: Discard X cards, gain X Zeal (Xmax = {0_xmax}) OR Draw X cards, lose X Zeal (Xmax = {1_xmax})
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.Uppercut:
Deal {0_damage} damage, draw a card.
Costs @con fewer action points.
Force the target to attack you on its next turn.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.HealingPalm:
Restore (@dex + @wis) × X hit points to the target.
X max = 2
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.Interruption:
Remove half of the target’s action points on its next turn. 
Can be played also at your turn
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.Osteology:
Summons a level X skeleton using the sacrifice score.
Level X: Costs X sacrifice.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.ShadowSpell:
Discard a card if you are in combat.
Deals {0_damage} necrotic damage to a target OR summons a level 1 skeleton if you target an adjacent square.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.ArcaneStrike:
Deals {0_damage} necrotic damage to a target.
Summons a level 2 skeleton on an adjacent square.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.BloodRitual:
Sacrifice a card.
Gain zeal equal to the number of skeletons in play.
This spell costs 2x@cha fewer action points
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.MorbidShift:
Destroy at least 1 skeleton.
Increase the movement of all other skeletons in play by @cha * sacrifice score.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.AdjustedShot:
Usable after missing a critical roll.
Increases critical chance by @int (lasts 2 turns).
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.SpikeTrap:
Deals {0_damage} piercing damage to a target that enters range (cannot critically hit),
where X is your critical score.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.PoisonTrap:
Deals {0_damage} poison damage (cannot critically hit)
then deals X damage over 3 turns, where X is your critical score.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.RootedShot:
Do not move this turn.
Deals your movement score + 1d(2 × @dex) piercing damage.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.RegainStrength:
Draw 2 cards.
Removes 2X critical for 2 turns. You regain X mana.
Xmax = {0_xmax}.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.MagicMissilesPlus:
Deals {0_damage} force damage to up to 3 targets.
Can only be used if 4 elemental effects are active on targets.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.MagicBarrier:
Grants 3X temporary hit points to all targets.
Xmax = {0_xmax}
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.GrowingOrb:
Deals {0_damage} damage.
X equals the number of squares between you and the target
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.AngelAndDemonEffect: The target is cursed and takes 4 + @wis damage each turn OR The target is blessed and regains 3 + @con hit points each turn.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.Combo2:
Increase critical by 2X for this attack.
Deals {0_damage} bludgeoning damage.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.SkeletonSorcerer:
Summons the Skeleton Sorcerer on an adjacent square.
Increase its hit points by @cha, its damage by @int, and its movement by @wis.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.EnragedBear: Summons an enraged bear on an adjacent square and increases its hit points by 3*@cha and its damage by @int + @dex.
